title: mannequin controlls
description: mannequin controlls allows you to move/pose mannequin easily and can be used as a mini library for a variety fo projects.
body:
Small library to help you controll and pose mannequins.

you can use:

function mannequin:man_movement/walk_forward
function mannequin:man_movement/walk_backward
function mannequin:man_movement/walk_left
function mannequin:man_movement/walk_right
function mannequin:man_movement/jump



The avaible poses are:
function mannequin:man_pose/crouching
function mannequin:man_pose/standing


(be sure to use this to execute on the manequin or to use the built in controlls for the movement options)
